answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring a unique willow of per-identity verifiable delay function proofs every epoch, bound to the agent key and a public umber beacon seed. A farm of N clones on shared hardware must serially complete N delay chains of about 30 seconds each, so total cost scales linearly with fakes while an honest agent pays once. The bridge between identities is the non-parallelizable delay, making mass cloning unprofitable as attacker compute cannot be amortized across heads.
